correctness.rationale: Exact gcd-class partition and counting bounds f(m) between 2^(m-1) and 2^m-1 yield the two-sided sandwich for all n>=4. The least excluded gcd for D is the least nondivisor and for Phi is the least prime factor. Explicit parity exponent gaps n/6 dominate the linear factor. The bundled verifier independently checks 397 cases and direct subsets through size 13.

value.rationale: The origin paper explicitly asks for two limit invariants of a natural ratio. The theorem determines both and establishes a uniform, prime-factor/nondivisor-dependent exponential growth law. The pointwise phase formula is stronger than a parity-only sign result. It does not extend to the requested partial sums.
